question: Identify the top 10 and bottom 10 interest categories based on their highest composition values across all months. For each category, display the time(MM-YYYY), interest name, and the composition value
sql:
-- Verify row count
WITH max_composition AS (
    SELECT 
        im.interest_id,
        im.month_year,
        im.composition,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY im.interest_id ORDER BY im.composition DESC, im.month_year ASC) as rn
    FROM interest_metrics im
    WHERE im.month_year IS NOT NULL
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        mc.interest_id,
        mc.month_year,
        mc.composition,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY mc.composition DESC) as top_rank,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY mc.composition ASC) as bottom_rank
    FROM max_composition mc
    WHERE mc.rn = 1
)
SELECT 
    r.month_year as time,
    im.interest_name,
    r.composition,
    r.top_rank,
    r.bottom_rank
FROM ranked r
JOIN interest_map im ON CAST(r.interest_id AS INTEGER) = im.id
WHERE r.top_rank <= 10 OR r.bottom_rank <= 10
ORDER BY r.composition DESC

WITH max_composition AS (
    SELECT 
        im.interest_id,
        im.month_year,
        im.composition,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY im.interest_id ORDER BY im.composition DESC, im.month_year ASC) as rn

    WHERE im.month_year IS NOT NULL
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT 
        mc.interest_id,
        mc.month_year,
        mc.composition,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY mc.composition DESC) as top_rank,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY mc.composition ASC) as bottom_rank
    FROM max_composition mc
    WHERE mc.rn = 1
)
SELECT 
    r.month_year as time,
    im.interest_name,
    r.composition
FROM ranked r
JOIN interest_map im ON CAST(r.interest_id AS INTEGER) = im.id
WHERE r.top_rank <= 10 OR r.bottom_rank <= 10
ORDER BY r.composition DESC
